question: In Brahmadeya villages under the Pallavas, which caste predominantly managed the local Sabha assemblies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brahmanas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the **Brahmadeya** villages under the **Pallavas**, the **Brahmanas** predominantly managed the **local Sabha assemblies**.
 
• A **Brahmadeya** was land gifted to **Brahmanas** by kings or other elites, often exempted from taxes, and granted for religious or educational purposes.
 
• The **Sabha** was a local assembly primarily composed of **learned Brahmanas** who were well-versed in **Vedic knowledge, rituals, and administration**.
 
• The **Sabha assemblies** played a vital role in governance at the local level, managing affairs like **land distribution, taxation, dispute resolution, and maintenance of temples and irrigation systems**.
 
• The **Pallava dynasty** (4th to 9th century CE) is known for its patronage of **Brahmanical traditions** and its emphasis on **temple architecture** and **religious practices.**
 
• Such villages and assemblies showcased the **integration of socio-religious and administrative systems**, highlighting the **dominance of Brahmanas** in the socio-political structure of early South Indian societies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Vaishyas**__

 __
 
• **Vaishyas** were traditionally associated with **trade, commerce, and agriculture** in the **Varna system** of ancient India.
 
• They played a significant role in the **economic activities** of society but were not directly involved in **administrative or governance activities** like the Sabha.
 
 
 
• **Shudras**__
 __
 
• **Shudras** were primarily associated with **manual labor and service roles** in the **Varna system**.
 
• They were generally excluded from **administrative and religious functions**, which were dominated by the Brahmanas and Kshatriyas.
 
 
 
• **Kshatriyas**__
 
 
• **Kshatriyas** were traditionally the **warrior class** responsible for **defense and governance** at higher levels, such as kingdoms and states.
 
• They were not involved in managing the **local assemblies like the Sabha**, which were specific to Brahmadeya villages.
